causal_order: bind birth cell from the first causal non-self BBO
derive each leg's independent eligibility clock from policy_anchor_ts plus its own frozen recut cell
require contemporaneous non-self micro flow/divot evidence
apply orientation only at the first-hour checkpoint
apply drift recognition only at the T6 checkpoint using history through T6
recut a leg only on that leg's causal book-cell change
apply sibling response only after the first leg's simulated full fill
cancel each still-resting leg independently at the declared policy horizon

clock_separation_law.policy_clock: policy_anchor_ts plus timestamped schedule observation and declared corridor only
clock_separation_law.evaluation_clock: evaluation_real_start_ts is accepted only by the separate ex-post evaluator

positive_size_law: zero, null, malformed, or synthetic transition size contributes zero and cannot trigger divot, flow, pressure, posture, walk, join, touch, park, recut, replenishment, or fill
own_order_law: fingerprints may subtract contributed book/print volume; fingerprinted activity is never fill, divot, flow, orientation, drift, or walk confirmation
shape_corpus: unavailable without independent non-AIM causal cell mapping
